b07f411e3e on claude/task-2272 — round-2 fixes:
1. major TASK-2280: guards fail closed — GUARD_HEARTBEAT_TTL_SECS removed; an unverifiable row (pid uncheckable from this namespace, no ended_at) counts live however old its heartbeat, so the duplicate launch is refused; only provable death (ended_at or checkable dead pid) frees the seat; tests for both paths.
2. minor TASK-2280: dispatch-health reports heartbeat-only rows as 'unverified (can't check liveness from here)', never 'dead agent ... salvage'; no resume/fallback routed at them; test added.
3. cosmetic TASK-2288/2310: ratchet drops instead/rather, negation must precede the tool name in its clause; self-test refuses 'with the Agent tool instead of a process' and 'with the Agent tool and no worktree'.
Targeted tests green; make check-ci-fast green (34 gates). PR title still '(Refs TASK-2272)'.
subject: PR-2868 pushed (TASK-2272)
